import.boolean_note: yes or no (yes, y, true, 1, oui, o — no, n, false, 0).
import.country_note: Two-letter country code (TN, FR). Left empty, the company's own applies.
import.identifier_note: The registration number the company's fiscal preset expects.
import.rate_note: A percentage without its % sign (5 for 5%), written with a comma or a point (5,5 or 5.5).

customers.number_note: How the customer is found again on a second import: it does not change.
customers.kind_note: company for a business, individual for a person.
customers.name: Name
customers.shipping_note: Fill in only when it differs from the billing address.
customers.group_note: The name of an existing customer group; create it before importing.
customers.tax_regime_note: The code of a regime the company knows.
customers.payment_terms_days_note: This customer’s terms in days, in place of its group’s or the company’s.
customers.credit_limit_note: What this customer may owe: beyond it, a notification says so after the invoice that passes it. 0 sets none.
customers.document_language_note: fr or en (French or English): the language its documents are printed in.
customers.exemption_reference_note: Printed for this customer when it is exempt, e.g. « article 261-4-4° du CGI ».

products.reference_note: How the product is found again on a second import: it does not change.
products.name: Name
products.kind_note: goods for something delivered, service for something performed.
products.tracking_note: none untracked, lot by lot, serial by serial number; chosen before the first stock movement, a service is not tracked.
products.substitution_group_note: Products sharing this name can stand in for one another when one is out of stock.
products.unit_code_note: The code of one of the company's units (H87 piece, HUR hour). Required for a new product.
products.category_note: The name of an existing category; create it before importing.
products.price_note: An amount written with a comma or a point. Required for a new product.
products.cost_note: What the product costs, so its margin can be worked out.
products.barcode_note: Without spaces; this is what the scanner reads.
products.pack_barcode_note: The code of one of this product’s packs: added, or updated when already there; its other packs stay.
products.pack_quantity_note: From 2 to 1,000,000. Left blank, a pack already there keeps its own.
products.supplier_number_note: The number of one of the company’s suppliers, the one printing the code in supplier_code.
products.supplier_code_note: The code this supplier prints on its carton: added, or updated when already there; the others stay.
products.home_location_note: The code of a stock location: it is what a receipt will propose.
products.reorder_point_note: The quantity at or under which the product is to be reordered, in its home location's establishment (or the only one).
products.reference_optional_note: Optional. Left empty, the product is given the next one of the company’s format, and a second import finds it again by its barcode.
products.location_note: The code of the location the quantity goes to. Left blank: the row’s or the product’s home location, else the establishment’s default location when there is only one.

vendors.number_note: How the vendor is found again on a second import: it does not change.
vendors.name: Name
vendors.payment_terms_note: A whole number of days after the vendor's invoice (30).
vendors.expense_category_note: The name of an active category; create it before importing.

opening_stock.reference_note: The reference of a product that already exists: import the products first.
opening_stock.location_code_note: The code of the location the goods were counted in, as it reads under Stock.
opening_stock.quantity_note: What is there, not what arrives: the same file imported twice leaves the same stock. With a comma or a point, within the unit's decimals.
opening_stock.reference_or_barcode_note: The product’s reference, or its unit barcode instead: import the products first.
opening_stock.barcode_note: The code the scanner reads on the item, for a row without a reference. Given both, they name the same product.
opening_stock.location_optional_note: The location’s code, as it appears under Stock. Left blank: the product’s home location, else the establishment’s default location when there is only one.
opening_stock.unit_cost_note: What one unit added cost. Left blank: the product’s cost. Never with a counted quantity.

import.title: Import {{subject}}
import.identity: A row is found again by: {{columns}}. At most {{rows}} rows per file.
import.no_company: Choose a company to import a file.
import.heading: What it is
import.required_note: A column marked with a star must be in the file, and filled in on every row.
import.mode_create: Create only: a row already known is refused.
import.mode_upsert: Create and update: a row already known is changed, and a blank cell keeps what is there.

encoding.label: File encoding
encoding.read_as: File read as {{encoding}}. Unreadable letters? Choose the file’s encoding.

import.preview_first: Preview first: nothing will be stored.

confirm_changes.title: Change existing records?
confirm_changes.message: {{records}} {records, plural, one {record changes} other {records change}}: {{fields}}. The values replaced are kept nowhere.

import.nothing_stored: Nothing was stored: fix the rows below and import the file again.

errors.network: The API cannot be reached. Try again in a moment.
errors.not_found: Nothing of the sort can be imported here, or you may not write it.
errors.invalid: The file could not be read.
errors.step_up_required: Nothing changed: confirm it is you to make this change.

refusals.unreadable: The file is neither a readable .csv nor a readable .xlsx.
refusals.unknown_columns: Unknown columns: {{columns}}. Start again from the template.
refusals.too_many_rows: The file is longer than {{limit}} rows. Split it into several files.
refusals.unreadable_encoding: The file’s header cannot be read in this encoding: choose the file’s own.

notes.name_shared: A product already has this name ({{reference}}): with neither a reference nor a barcode, this row makes another one.
notes.name_held: Another product already has this name ({{reference}}).
notes.identifier_missing: Without this registration number, this customer cannot be invoiced: add it before issuing one.

stock.stock_add_note: What arrives on top of what is there: a receipt, at the product’s cost. With a comma or a point, within the unit’s decimals.
stock.stock_count_note: What is there, replacing what the stock says: the same file imported twice leaves the same stock. One of the two quantities per row.
stock.recount_note: Counts again a location where goods came in or went out since its last count: the file’s counted quantity then replaces that stock.
stock.ignore_quantities_note: To reuse a catalogue for its prices alone: no stock is touched.

import.already_imported: This file was already imported on {{date}}. Importing it again does what it does again: check the quantities to add before you confirm.
